review_text: It’s only my second time in Davao, but I had to make sure I returned to Karlo’s Gourmet & Coffee — the very first café I visited in Davao City back in 2018! Talk about a full-circle moment. We ordered their frappes and honestly… it’s as simple as it gets. Sometimes simple really hits the spot. We also got their ube cheesecake to go and WOW — it’s actually really good. Creamy, flavorful, and definitely something I’d order again (and again 👀). The staff were just as warm and welcoming as I remember from my first visit years ago. It’s nice when a place keeps its quality and its heart. Right beneath the café is Jack’s Ridge. So after happily loading up on carbs and sugar, you can trek down (and eventually climb back up 😅) for an instant leg day. Dessert first, cardio later — balance, right? Looking forward to visiting this place for the third time soon.

The view is insane.. a 360 degree paronama of davao city... The cream of the top is their exotic blending of coffee.. mine is their mangosteen frapuccino.. its new for me but it was soo good.. thanks for the experience.. kudos!

Karlos Gourmet & Coffee has a cozy vibe and unique menu selections. I wasn’t able to take a picture before cutting the cupcake, but it tasted really good - moist and flavorful. We tried the cookies and cream cold drink. I didn’t try their coffee, but they also offer exotic blends like jackfruit, durian, and mangosteen.

We ordered Daing na Bangus, Karlo’s Full Breakfast, and the Chicken Caesar Salad. Wow, I'm in heaven!!!! The Bangus was perfectly cooked; even the fish bone was crispy-fried, and nothing was left on the plate. Karlo’s Full breakfast is the best value and best in taste. The fried potatoes and the bacon are heavenly crispy fried, but not oily or soggy at all. You can also smell that the cooking oil is very fresh. The sunny-side-up eggs, were the first thing gone from the plates. It's really that good!!!! The Chicken Caesar Salad, how do I put it……. It's better than the Salad from S&R. Not just fresh, but made just for you. If you are first time in Jack’s Ridge, don't let the fancy indoor environment scare you off as if all is gonna be very expensive. All prices are very fair and affordable. We will for sure come back again and won't go to other restaurants at all.
The drinks were fine. The place is definitely worth spending time in and taking in the view. Maybe it was just an off-day but the staff seemed cold.

The line “You never start near home” holds true to me. I mean literally, that is. It’s so close by to where I……More often than not the norm is usually postponing, evading, or plainly avoiding the way here knowing there’s always time to drop by whenever. The first place I’ve been to overlooking a part of this city. Each visit no doubt is for the VIEW. Over a decade and I can say the area is well-kept. Rates are affordably familiar. And with coffee mixed with flavors of durian, mangosteen, and marang that are homegrown adds a bit of a nod also. So, for out-of-towners, you might want to insert this once on your trip.

I tried the mangosteen coffee frappe which I found to be slightly sour. They also offer sandwiches and pasta dishes. It was refreshing to have a snack here especially after hours of walking under the sun.

Let’s do a take 2 of the review of this place; for some strange reason my first review got erased from this page. Welcome back to Davao! After almost 2 years this is my first time to travel again and does it feel great to be back here in this city! And having dinner here tonight at Karlo’s is a sure way to start my Christmas break. Of course the souffléd pancakes are still unbeatable…thick and fluffy and oh so delicious (yes pancakes for dinner!)…also had the chorizo pasta which was still good as well, nachos (looked pale and bare but actually very tasty) and the apple pie (not bad). And to top it off, a hot cup of durian coffee (with real durian bits)… This is a good start…Karlo’s has maintained its quality and I am happy to be back here! And what we missed are the pictures as all our phones’ batteries have been drained due to the season! I hope this review does not get erased again! Happy Christmas everyone!

The location offers a panoramic view of Davao City. The cafe is located on a slight slope, so while the entrance to Jack's Ridge is flat, the area overlooking Davao City is sloping, and the moment you look down on the lush green lawn below, you'll feel a sense of peace. It's almost as if you're about to sing a song on the circular lawn. The decor is modern, with bats at the center, and the indoor and outdoor seating is quite spacious. The staff are friendly, and the food is served quickly and deliciously. The durian coffee is especially worth trying. This cafe is highly recommended for both young people and sophisticated gentlemen. I highly recommend taking a stroll around Jack's Ridge after a cup of tea, or before. The fact that you can order a variety of delicious dishes for breakfast, lunch, and dinner is a real treat.
